episodes.title: Old Friends, New Names
episodes.summary: Struggling to make ends meet as a waiter, Pete takes a job working for his friend Tiff -- aka Mistress May -- in her sex dungeon.

episodes.title: Pete Shy
episodes.summary: Pete gets stage fright, a customer's phone number and a lesson in tying knots. Tiff consults with Daphne, a prospective client.

episodes.title: The Past is Not Always Behind
episodes.summary: Pete's roommate makes him an offer that's hard to refuse. Tiff and Pete run into an old -- and very drunk -- acquaintance.

episodes.title: Let's Get Physical
episodes.summary: Tiff and Pete visit Daphne's immaculate home. Pete gears up for a coffee date with Josh, and Tiff interrupts a troubling encounter.

episodes.title: Double Date
episodes.summary: Pete and Tiff argue as they get ready for their dates. While Josh and Pete flirt at a burlesque show, Doug tries to win over Tiff.

episodes.title: Penguins
episodes.summary: When Tiff doesn't show up for work, Pete takes charge. Tiff reveals to Doug that she's a dominatrix, and Pete gives stand-up another shot.

episodes.title: Into the Woods
episodes.summary: After some nudging from Daphne and Andrew, Tiff and Pete make up. Back in business, they meet a wealthy new client at his place.

episodes.title: The Kinks
episodes.summary: Ten months after their disastrous house call, Tiff and Pete's reputation is still trashed, so they seek help from Tiff's former mentor.

episodes.title: Dog Days
episodes.summary: A jealous Tiff accidentally calls Doug her boyfriend. Pete tries to be understanding with Josh — and embraces his submissive side.

episodes.title: Personal
episodes.summary: As a test, Mistress Mira sends Tiff and Pete to work with her personal submissive, who enjoys being financially dominated. Doug opens up to Tiff.

episodes.title: Threesomes
episodes.summary: Frank gets a job at a gay bar. Thrown together, Tiff and Gina bond. Pete meets Josh's ex — who looks exactly like Pete.

episodes.title: Nanci
episodes.summary: With Pete's support, Josh says he's ready to come out to his dad and co-workers. Tiff helps an old classmate conquer her fears.

episodes.title: The Lost Egg
episodes.summary: Tiff tells Pete they need to quit working together. Doug's frustrations with Tiff boil over, and Pete prepares to meet Josh's dad.

episodes.title: Stand Me Up, Stand Me Down
episodes.summary: Blowups with Tiff and Josh leave Pete feeling crushed. And now he has to do a stand-up set with an agent in the audience.

episodes.title: Permission
episodes.summary: As their friendship falters and their paths diverge, Tiff and Pete navigate permission, consent, betrayal — and new opportunities.
